blurb: Bentwater Golf Club is a private golf club near Marietta and Kennesaw with a parkland-style Mike Dasher golf course featuring nearly 7,000 yards and views of Red Top Mountain. The club offers various membership options with golf access, social events, dining venues, and hosts private events such as weddings and corporate meetings. Members can enjoy a full calendar of social and golf events, leagues, and tournaments.
extraNote: Memberships are month-to-month with no long-term contracts · One-time admission fee required for membership · Tours available by appointment
